answer: Resist sybils by requiring every identity to lock a refundable bond before it can vote or receive emissions. The bond is set as one marble of scarce, attested compute credit. If a new account's work falls within a published similarity delta of another account's already graded rationale, the later bond is burned and both lose payout rights for that epoch. Cloning identities then costs a full deposit each time and cannot harvest extra nectar from the same idea. Only independently scored, distinct work unlocks the bond.
